semiconductor_relevance: High — Syft Technologies specializes in chemical analysis solutions that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Syft Technologies provides advanced chemical analysis solutions, particularly through their Selected Ions Flow Tube Mass Spectrometry (SIFT-MS) technology. This technology is utilized for monitoring air quality, detecting contaminants in clean rooms, and ensuring product quality in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Selected Ions Flow Tube Mass Spectrometry (SIFT-MS)

regional_presence.Korea: Syft Technologies established its Korean office in July 2018 to expand its presence in the region.
